definitions.explanation: A short piece of writing on a particular subject, often reflecting the author's personal thoughts and experiences.

notes:
{随筆|ずいひつ} is the Japanese term for personal essays. The genre has a long history in Japan, with classics like ⟦{枕草子|まくらのそうし}→枕草子：noentry⟧ (The Pillow Book) and ⟦{徒然草|つれづれぐさ}→徒然草：noentry⟧ (Essays in Idleness).

The word literally means 'writing following the brush' (⟦{随|ずい}→随：noentry⟧ = following, ⟦{筆|ひつ}→筆：03601_fude⟧ = brush/pen), suggesting the informal, flowing nature of the writing.

COMPOUNDS:
- {随筆|ずいひつ}⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧: essayist
- {随筆|ずいひつ}⟦{集|しゅう}→集：noentry⟧: essay collection

CLASSIC JAPANESE ESSAYS:
- ⟦{枕草子|まくらのそうし}→枕草子：noentry⟧: The Pillow Book (Sei Shōnagon)
- ⟦{徒然草|つれづれぐさ}→徒然草：noentry⟧: Essays in Idleness (Yoshida Kenkō)
- ⟦{方丈記|ほうじょうき}→方丈記：noentry⟧: An Account of My Hut (Kamo no Chōmei)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦エッセイ→エッセイ：10724_essei⟧: essay (loanword, more commonly used in modern contexts)
